stemMd: How many solutions does $\cos x=0$ have in $0\le x<2\pi$?
explanationMd: Cosine vanishes at $\pi/2$ and $3\pi/2$ in this interval. Neither endpoint is a zero.

distractorRationale.d: Counts sine zeros as cosine zeros too.
